us_gaap_ScheduleOfAllocationOfPlanAssets.description: The following table presents the fair values of the assets of our pension plans (in millions) as of December 31, 2024 and 2023 by level of the fair value hierarchy. Assets categorized in Level 1 of the hierarchy are measured at fair value using a market approach based on unadjusted quoted prices from national securities exchanges. Assets categorized in Level 2 of the hierarchy are measured at net asset value in a market that is not active or using inputs other than quoted prices that are observable. No assets were categorized in Level 3 of the hierarchy as of December 31, 2024 and 2023. As previously noted, we do not fund or fully fund U.S. nonqualified and certain foreign pension plans that are not subject to funding requirements, and we do not fund our other postretirement benefit plans.
